label: Saturation
intent: Low to high: colour is added and the saturation rises. Light: a drop of colour forms under the tip, falls through the drop and lands in the colour; on contact the level rises from a fifth to just above half in one decisive fill while the surface sloshes and settles level. Strong: two drops land in turn and the level climbs in two clicks that stop dead, each landing sloshing the surface harder. The level never overshoots and the drop never moves. Reverse drains the colour back down with a small slosh as it lands.

droplet.//: hidden at rest: the colour that arrives; behind the level so the colour swallows it

level.//: v1's low and high colour levels (chords at y 23.4 and 15.6) cut from the bowl circle at r 7.5 instead of v1's 7: the extra 0.5 lies under the drop's stroke (0.75 at Light) and in front of it in the same colour, so rest and end look exactly like v1, and mid-rise the linear morph stays at most 0.62 inside the wall, still under the stroke; the 'fill' driver raises it

liquid.//: the centre of the drop's round bowl (r 7): a slosh keeps the colour's edge on the wall

droplet.y.//: falls from under the tip into the colour: 9.3 down to the low level, 5.5 to the half level

fill.//: a data value: it stops on its level and never goes past it

reverse.//: the colour drains straight back down (no droplet rises out), and the surface sloshes once as it lands
